summary: Candidate is a distinct D3.js micro-skill for configuring rendering context and numerical precision on link generators. It does not semantically match any existing skill: the three existing skills address Next.js Link prefetching, Future callback registration, and layout shift prevention—all in different domains (web framework, async programming, CSS layout). The peer candidates (line accessor setup, radial link accessor binding, delimiter parser) are related D3 path-generation skills but operate on different generator types (line vs. link) and different configuration aspects (accessors/curves vs. rendering backend/precision). The candidate's focus on context() and digits() methods for link generators is a novel capability.
